[image: Trans Rights in Federal Custody illustration] Trans Rights in Federal Custody Federal policy now houses trans women in men's facilities by categorical rule and has ended hormone therapy access entirely. Lydia will require housing to match completed surgical transition, restore case-by-case PREA safety review, and restore access to medically necessary hormone therapy. Read More
